messages:
maja: kicking off a late-night toggle for llm-route behind flag `ff.llmroute.v3` — change window 22:00-23:30, plan: 0% -> 2% over 10m, then 2% -> 10% over 30m if stable. deploy-bot: rollout scheduled id=rb-4771 (link: https://releases/internal/rb-4771)

devin: ack. leo, can you apply the region pin for APAC for the first hour? want to keep them on v2 while we watch.

leo: applying pin: `deploy-bot pin-cohort --cohort=apac --service=llm-route --version=v2 --ttl=60m`
deploy-bot: pin applied (pin_id=pin-477A)

maja: throttles set: v3 concurrency cap per node=6, global inflight cap=150. observability: p50/p95 latency, error_rate, kernel-fallback-rate. alerts: p95>1500ms or kernel-fallback-rate>0.5%

ops-bot: reminder: release-notes template prefilled for rb-4771; include short blurb about staged rollout.

devin: starting the ramp now. deploy-bot: starting rollout rb-4771 -> traffic 2% (canary: us-west)

leo: seeing small error blip in canary 5m in: 0.1% -> 0.6% 502s. correlates with requests with seq>800.

maja: pausing ramp. deploy-bot: pause rollout rb-4771 (reason: canary error spike)

devin: can we drain canary and shift back to v2 while we debug? leo: yes, initiating partial rollback for canary cohort. deploy-bot: partial rollback rb-4771 -> revert canary subset to v2
deploy-bot: partial rollback complete (rb-4771) — canary reverted, staged pin for apac still active

maja: leaving the apac pin in place until we have a root cause. ops-bot: adding release-note entry: "v3 staged rollout paused; canary partial rollback due to 5xx spike correlated with long-sequence requests; apac cohort pinned to v2."

devin: filing ISSUE-5012 with traces and kernel-fallback metrics. initial hypothesis: quantized vector-mul fallback regression under boundary seq sizes.

leo: removing global canary pin (we only left apac). deploy-bot: removed global canary pin

maja: next steps — devin to open perf bug, leo to prepare a constrained experiment (1% traffic, seq<=512) after patch, ops to coordinate any customer comms if we see regression on more cohorts.
deploy-bot: updated ticket https://issues/internal/ISSUE-5012 (status: investigating)

devin: noted. thanks all, will update when there's a fix candidate. :thumbsup:

maja: closing chat; follow-ups tracked in ISSUE-5012.
